card.name: Missed-dose and meal-timing phrasing
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "is", "the", "main" or "while" inside dose-timing instructions, mostly in "If a dose ... is missed" and "with the first/main meal". Also fires on the "ron" of cron in file paths.

modes.label: Missed dose wording
modes.description: The word "is" in "If a dose of DRUG is missed" or "If it is almost time for the next dose".
modes.example: If a dose of XOCOVA<< is>> missed, take the missed dose as soon

modes.label: Meal or activity timing
modes.description: A linking word before a meal or activity that sets when to take the drug.
modes.example: preferably after the<< main>> meal. To reduce the risk of malaria

modes.label: Cron file path
modes.description: The "ron" in cron within Unix file paths.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are wake/waking words in English and Chinese, so it mildly steers away from wake-related continuations.
card.plain: It marks the small words in dosing-schedule instructions, such as what to do about a missed dose or when in the day to take it.
